summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst under Utilities, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests from the spec). Nothing was run, so tests and black/flake8 are unverified; a scan confirmed no lines over 120 columns in the new or changed Python files. Nothing was committed. Choices made where the spec was silent: non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; malformed JSON raises ValueError naming the file; image and label are resolved only when present; items are shallow-copied.
